  <text x="151" y="174" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#736E6E">Quantity</text>

  <text x="151" y="211" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#282C3F">$6,400.00</text>

  <text x="30" y="278" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#282C3F">Delivery address</text>
  <rect x="30" y="292" width="330" height="78" rx="16" fill="#808080" opacity=".12"/>

  <text x="341" y="502" text-anchor="end" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#006032">Complimentary</text>

  <text x="341" y="532" text-anchor="end" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#282C3F">$568.00</text>

  <polyline points="333,657 339,663 333,669" fill="none" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- CTA -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="706" width="330" height="48" rx="8" fill="#AA7455"/>
    <text x="195" y="736" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Open Sans, Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Proceed to Pay · $6,968.00</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="780" x2="390" y2="780" stroke="#282C3F" stroke-opacity=".12"/>

    <line x1="239" y1="803" x2="248" y2="803" stroke="#AA7455" stroke-width="1.5"/>
